prompt: An original, severely abstract dark cubist mural in compressed shallow space, painted as one rough surface in charcoal-black, dirty ivory, warm chalk, ash-gray and smoke-gray. Construct the image with large, rounded and jagged interlocking forms that clash aggressively. The protagonist Liu is central, arms outstretched, face distorted with fear and helplessness. Faces fractured and displaced, bodies broad and overlapping with deliberate discontinuity. Use raw charcoal, broken brush marks, scraped pigment and worn plaster textures with muted colors. No national symbols or text. Figures and setting fused into one unstable painted surface.
